title: Behind England’s bumper A-level results lie record levels of regional disparities

paragraphs.en: Andy Burnham has put regional inequality at the top of his agenda as prime minister, and nowhere is the need for doing so clearer than in education.
paragraphs.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）就任首相后，把地区不平等列为头号议程，而没有任何地方比教育更能体现这一举措的必要性。

paragraphs.en: As England’s A-level results were published on Thursday morning, students across the country were pictured celebrating a bumper crop of results, with record rates of As and A*s .
paragraphs.zh: 随着英格兰A-level（高级水平考试）成绩于周四上午公布，全国各地的学生都被拍到庆祝丰收般的佳绩，A 和 A* 的获得比例创下纪录。

paragraphs.en: Drill down into the detail, however, and the regional disparities are shocking, with the gap between London and the lowest performing areas of the country also at record levels.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，深入细节之后会发现，地区差距令人震惊，伦敦与全国表现最差地区之间的差距同样达到历史最高水平。

paragraphs.en: Nearly a third of A-level candidates in the capital (32.7%) gained A*s and As, up six percentage points on last year.
paragraphs.zh: 首都近三分之一的 A-level 考生（32.7%）获得了 A* 和 A 级成绩，比去年上升了六个百分点。

paragraphs.en: In the East Midlands, however, less than a quarter (23.1%) secured top grades, down from 23.8% in 2025, putting it level with the north-east, which increased its share of top grades marginally from 22.9% last year.
paragraphs.zh: 然而在东米德兰兹（East Midlands），只有不到四分之一（23.1%）的考生获得顶尖成绩，较 2025 年的 23.8% 有所下降，与东北部地区持平——东北部的顶尖成绩占比则较去年的 22.9% 略有上升。

paragraphs.en: The results reveal the gap in A and A* grades between London and the north-east has grown to an alarming 9.6 percentage points, the largest since the pandemic and significantly higher than the 2019 pre-pandemic disparity of 3.9 points.
paragraphs.zh: 结果显示，伦敦与东北部之间在 A 和 A* 成绩上的差距已扩大到惊人的 9.6 个百分点，这是疫情以来的最大差距，也远高于 2019 年疫情前 3.9 个百分点的差距。

paragraphs.en: The gap in A* grades is up from two percentage points in 2019 to 5.1 points in 2026. Experts are hoping the prime minister’s devolution plans to give regional areas the independence to adapt their approach to local conditions will help learners outside London.
paragraphs.zh: A* 成绩的差距已从 2019 年的两个百分点上升到 2026 年的 5.1 个百分点。专家们希望，首相的权力下放计划——赋予各地区自主权，使其能够因地制宜地调整教育方式——将有助于伦敦以外的学子。

paragraphs.en: Lee Elliot Major, a professor of social mobility at Exeter University, said: “Our capital has become an educational outlier while too many young people in the north-east, East Midlands and other parts of the country are growing up in very different worlds of opportunity.
paragraphs.zh: 埃克塞特大学（University of Exeter）社会流动学教授李·艾略特·梅杰（Lee Elliot Major）表示：“我们的首都已成为教育上的异类，而太多生活在东北部、东米德兰兹以及英国其他地区的年轻人，却在截然不同的机遇世界中成长。”
